内容提要
上集“走麦城”，叙孙权乘虚袭取荆州，关羽困守麦
城，孤军突围，被东吴擒杀。
本集叙曹操患病，延华陀诊治，华陀要破脑除风，曹操疑是他蓄意谋害，追拷下狱。曹操病死，诸子争立，曹丕得华
歆、贾诩等画策，嗣为魏王，旋即废去汉献帝自立。
下集“刘备征吴”，叙刘备为关羽、张飞报仇，倾师征吴，孙
权拜陆逊为大将，大破蜀军。
1. 东吴杀了关羽，怕刘备兴兵报仇，想了一计，用木匣盛起关羽的首级，
派人送给曹操。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
In the previous chapter, "Escape from Macheng," it narrates how Sun Quan took advantage of the situation to seize Jingzhou, Guan Yu was trapped in Macheng, fought his way out with a small force, and was captured and killed by Eastern Wu.
This chapter narrates that Cao Cao fell ill and invited Hua Tuo to treat him. Hua Tuo wanted to perform brain surgery to remove the wind, but Cao Cao suspected he was plotting to harm him, so he was arrested and tortured. After Cao Cao died, his sons vied for power. Cao Pi, with the advice of Hua Xin and Jia Xu, succeeded as King of Wei, and soon deposed Emperor Xian of Han to establish his own rule.
In the next chapter, "Liu Bei's Campaign Against Wu," it narrates how Liu Bei, seeking revenge for Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, launched a full-scale campaign against Wu. Sun Quan appointed Lu Xun as his general and decisively defeated the Shu army.
1. Eastern Wu killed Guan Yu. Fearing that Liu Bei would launch a military campaign for revenge, they devised a plan: they placed Guan Yu's head in a wooden box and sent it to Cao Cao.
summary_zh: 本页包含《兄弟爭王》的内容提要，概述了上集、本集和下集的主要情节，并配有一幅插图及文字说明：东吴杀死关羽后，为防刘备报仇，将关羽首级装入木匣派人送给曹操。

2. 这时，曹操已回洛阳，接见了东吴使者，非常高兴。对左右道：“云长已死，我可以高枕无忧了。”
3. 曹操刚说完，阶下一人，忽然站出来说：“此是东吴嫁祸于人的鬼计啊！”曹操一看，乃是主簿（官名）司马懿，忙问他其中缘故。
page_text_en:
2. At this time, Cao Cao had returned to Luoyang and received the envoy from Eastern Wu. He was very happy and said to those around him, "Yunchang is dead. I can now rest easy." 
3. Just as Cao Cao finished speaking, someone from below the steps suddenly stepped forward and said, "This is a sinister plot by Eastern Wu to shift blame onto others!" Cao Cao looked and saw that it was Sima Yi, the Chief Clerk (an official title), and hurriedly asked him the reason behind it.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹操在洛阳接见东吴使者，得知关羽已死后大感安心，但随即被主簿司马懿指出这是东吴嫁祸的计谋，曹操因此询问缘由。

4. 司马懿说：“从前刘、关、张在桃园结义的时候，誓同生死。如今东吴害了关羽，怕刘备复仇，故意将首级献来，使刘备迁怒于大王，不攻吴而攻魏，他却坐观胜败……”曹操恍然大悟，忙问他有什么对付的办法没有。
5. 司马懿主张将关羽的首级，雕刻一香木身躯配起来，葬以大臣之礼。这样，刘备必然深恨孙权，尽力南征。魏可以坐收渔人之利。曹操大喜，决定按照他的话做。
page_text_en:
4. Sima Yi said, "In the past, Liu, Guan, and Zhang swore brotherhood in the Peach Garden, vowing to share life and death. Now, Eastern Wu has killed Guan Yu, fearing Liu Bei's revenge, so they deliberately sent his head to make Liu Bei angry at Your Majesty, causing him to attack Wei instead of Wu, while they sit back and watch the outcome..." Cao Cao suddenly realized the truth and hurriedly asked him if he had any way to deal with it.
5. Sima Yi proposed to take Guan Yu's head, carve a wooden body to match it, and bury it with the rites of a minister. This way, Liu Bei would surely hate Sun Quan deeply and launch a full-scale southern campaign. Wei could then reap the benefits of the situation. Cao Cao was delighted and decided to follow his advice.
summary_zh: 司马懿向曹操分析东吴送关羽首级是嫁祸之计，建议以大臣之礼安葬关羽，使刘备攻打东吴，魏国坐收渔利，曹操采纳了此计策。

6. 曹操用王侯之礼，把关羽葬在洛阳南门以外。他亲自拜祭，赠为荆王，差官守墓。安葬好，打发吊使回去。
7. 不久，曹操头风旧疾，忽又发作，传令遍求良医治疗，不能痊愈。
page_text_en:
6. Cao Cao buried Guan Yu outside the southern gate of Luoyang with the rites of a king or marquis. He personally paid his respects, posthumously honored him as King of Jing, assigned officials to guard the tomb. After the burial, he sent the mourning envoy back.
7. Soon after, Cao Cao's old headache illness flared up again. He issued orders to seek out skilled physicians everywhere, but could not be cured.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹操以王侯之礼安葬关羽，并亲自拜祭、追封其为荆王；随后，曹操的头风旧疾复发，遍求良医却未能痊愈。

8. 华歆入奏：‘华佗是当世神医，请得他来，大王的病可望根治。’曹操便派人连夜去请华佗来。
9. 华佗当时在金城，请来之后，便令入内诊脉。
page_text_en:
8. Hua Xun reported: 'Hua Tuo is a renowned physician of our time. If we can bring him here, Your Majesty's illness may be cured completely.' Cao Cao then sent people to urgently invite Hua Tuo.
9. Hua Tuo was then in Jincheng. After being summoned, he was allowed to enter to take the pulse.
summary_zh: 曹操头风病复发，华歆推荐神医华佗，曹操派人连夜请来华佗为其诊脉。

10. 华佗诊视了好一会，便说头风的病根在脑袋中，服汤药是没有什么用的。必须先饮麻沸汤，然后用利斧砍开脑袋，取出风涎，方才可以除根。
11. 曹操怒道：“你要杀害我吗？”华佗道：“以前关公右臂曾中过毒箭，我替他刮骨疗毒，关公毫无惧怕。如今大王患病，怎么这样多疑呢？”
page_text_en:
10. Hua Tuo examined him for a while, then said the root of the headache was in the brain, and taking herbal medicine would be of no use. He must first drink the麻沸汤 (mafei tang), then use a sharp axe to open the skull and remove the wind phlegm, only then could the illness be cured.
11. Cao Cao angrily said, "Are you trying to kill me?" Hua Tuo replied, "In the past, General Guan Yu's right arm was pierced by a poisoned arrow, and I scraped the bone to remove the poison. General Guan Yu showed no fear at all. Now that Your Majesty is ill, why are you so suspicious?"
summary_zh: 华佗为曹操诊治头风病，提出需开颅取风涎的疗法，曹操对此极为怀疑并质问华佗，华佗以曾为关羽刮骨疗毒为例，劝其不要多疑。

12. 曹操听他这样一说，更加疑虑，以为他要替关公报仇。忙命左右将华佗拿下，拷问实情。
13. 众官劝谏道：“华佗医术精深，当世无双，他医大王的病，一定有些把握。”曹操坚决不信，急令拷问。
page_text_en:
12. Cao Cao, upon hearing this, became even more suspicious, thinking he was seeking revenge for Guan Gong. He immediately ordered his attendants to seize Hua Tuo and interrogate him.
13. The officials pleaded, "Hua Tuo's medical skills are profound and unmatched in the world; he must have some confidence in curing the King's illness." Cao Cao refused to believe them and urgently ordered Hua Tuo to be tortured.
summary_zh: 曹操因怀疑华佗为关羽报仇而将其拿下拷问，众官劝谏称华佗医术高明，但曹操仍不信，执意拷问。

14. 华佗因年迈体弱，经不住严刑拷打，病死狱中。华佗死后，曹操病势加重。忽报东吴遣使上书，曹操就枕上拆书观看。乃是孙权拥戴他做皇帝，并劝他进兵剿灭刘备，说两川一平，东吴愿意马上归降称臣。
15. 曹操看完了孙权的来书，大笑着把这封书信递给群臣看，说道：“孙权用心，我怎么会不知道？他是想把我摆在炉火上烤呢！”
page_text_en:
14. Hua Tuo, due to his old age and frailty, could not withstand severe torture and died in prison. After Hua Tuo's death, Cao Cao's illness worsened. Suddenly, a report came that Eastern Wu had sent an envoy with a letter. Cao Cao tore open the letter while lying in bed. It was from Sun Quan, who was acclaiming him as emperor and urging him to lead troops to eliminate Liu Bei, saying that once the two Shu regions were pacified, Eastern Wu would immediately surrender and become his vassal.
15. After reading Sun Quan's letter, Cao Cao laughed loudly and handed the letter to his ministers, saying, "Sun Quan's intentions, how could I not know? He wants to put me on the fire and roast me!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了华佗因被曹操怀疑而遭拷打致死，曹操病势加重后收到孙权的劝进书信，识破其借刀杀人之计，并向群臣揭露孙权的用心。

16. 侍中陈群奏道：“汉朝久已衰微，大王功高无比。如今东吴归顺，正好废汉自立。”曹操大笑说：“我事汉多年，虽有功德，然已封为魏王，何敢更有他望？假使儿孙辈争气，且让他们去做皇帝吧。
17. 司马懿道：“孙权既称臣归附，大王可给他封官赐爵，叫他牵制刘备。”曹操听从了他的话，表奏孙权为骠骑将军南昌侯，领荆州牧，并遣使到东吴去。
page_text_en:
16. Minister Chen Qun presented: "The Han dynasty has long been in decline, Your Majesty's merits are unmatched. Now that Eastern Wu has submitted, it is the perfect time to abolish the Han and establish your own rule." Cao Cao laughed and said: "I have served the Han for many years, though I have merits, I have already been made King of Wei. How dare I have other ambitions? If my descendants are capable, let them become emperors.
17. Sima Yi said: "Since Sun Quan has submitted as a vassal, Your Majesty may grant him official titles and ranks, so that he can restrain Liu Bei." Cao Cao followed his advice, and submitted a memorial to appoint Sun Quan as General of the Flying Cavalry, Marquis of Nanchang, Governor of Jingzhou, and sent an envoy to Eastern Wu.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了侍中陈群劝曹操废汉自立，曹操拒绝并表示愿将帝位留给子孙；随后司马懿建议曹操封赏孙权以牵制刘备，曹操采纳此策并派遣使者前往东吴。

18. 又数日，曹操自知不起，召曹洪、司马懿等到卧榻前，嘱托后事道：
“我纵横天下三十余年，只剩孙权、刘备尚未剿灭。今病势危殆，怕不能与卿等相聚了。”
19. 曹操喘息一会，又道：“我生四子，次子曹彰勇而无谋，三子曹植华而不实，幼子曹熊体弱多病。只有长子曹丕，笃厚恭谨，可以继承大业，卿等要好好扶助他。”
page_text_en:
18. After several more days, Cao Cao, knowing he was near death, summoned Cao Hong, Sima Yi, and others to his bedside and entrusted them with his final wishes: 
"I have dominated the world for over thirty years, yet Sun Quan and Liu Bei remain undefeated. My condition is now critical; I fear I will not be able to meet with you all again."
19. After catching his breath, Cao Cao continued: "I have four sons. My second son, Cao Zhang, is brave but lacks strategy. My third son, Cao Zhi, is talented but insubstantial. My youngest son, Cao Xiong, is frail and often ill. Only my eldest son, Cao Pi, is sincere and respectful—he is fit to inherit the great cause. You must all support him well."
summary_zh: 曹操病重，自知将不久于人世，召见曹洪、司马懿等重臣，交代后事，表示孙权、刘备尚未消灭，遗憾不能与群臣再聚；随后他评价四个儿子，认为长子曹丕笃厚恭谨，可继承大业，嘱托群臣好好扶助。

20. 曹操又命近侍取出平日所藏名香，分赐姬妾。并且叮嘱她们：“今后要勤习针线，多作绣鞋，卖了钱也可养活自己。”
21. 最后，曹操遗命将自己葬在彰德城外，为防人盗掘，设立疑冢七十二座。曹洪等涕泣领命。只见曹操长叹一声，泪下如雨，霎时气绝而死了。
page_text_en:
20. Cao Cao then ordered his attendants to bring out the precious incense he had stored and distributed it among his concubines. He instructed them: 'In the future, you must diligently learn needlework, make many embroidered shoes, and sell them to support yourselves.'
21. Finally, Cao Cao left instructions to be buried outside Zhangde City, and to prevent grave robbers, he ordered the construction of seventy-two false tombs. Cao Hong and others wept as they accepted the order. Cao Cao let out a long sigh, tears streaming down like rain, and suddenly passed away.
summary_zh: 曹操临终前分赐名香给姬妾并叮嘱她们自力更生，随后遗命葬于彰德城外并设七十二疑冢以防盗墓，最终长叹一声气绝而亡。

22. 众官用金馆银椁将曹操入殓，连夜出丧，护着灵榇向邺城而去。
23. 曹丕在邺城接到父亲的死讯，放声痛哭。率大小官员出城十里，迎榇进城，停在殿上。
page_text_en:
22. The officials placed Cao Cao in a golden coffin and silver casket, held a nighttime funeral procession, and escorted the coffin to Ye City.
23. Cao Pi, upon receiving the news of his father's death in Ye City, wept loudly. He led officials of all ranks out ten miles to meet the coffin, brought it into the city, and placed it in the palace.
summary_zh: 曹操死后，众官将其入殓并护送灵柩前往邺城；曹丕在邺城得知父亲死讯，痛哭并率众官员出城迎接灵柩入城安放。

24. 正伤悼间，华歆自许昌飞马而来，说道：“魏王病逝，天下震动，何不早请世子嗣位？”众官都道：“皇帝的诏命未到，不可造次。”
25. 华歆道：“我已在汉帝跟前讨来了诏命。”随即在怀中取出诏命开读。原来华歆奉承曹丕，他写了个诏书，威逼献帝发下来。献帝只好听从，下诏封曹丕为魏王，丞相领冀州牧。
page_text_en:
24. While mourning, Hua Xun arrived from Xuchang on horseback, saying, "The King of Wei has passed away; the world is in turmoil. Why not quickly invite the crown prince to ascend the throne?" The officials replied, "The emperor's decree has not yet arrived; we must not act rashly.
25. Hua Xun said, "I have already obtained the imperial decree from Emperor Xian." He then took the decree from his bosom and read it aloud. It turned out that Hua Xun, flattery to Cao Pi, had written the decree himself and forced Emperor Xian to issue it. Emperor Xian had no choice but to comply, issuing an edict to appoint Cao Pi as King of Wei, Chancellor, and Governor of Jizhou.
summary_zh: 曹操病逝后，华歆从许昌赶来，主张立即请世子曹丕继位，但众官认为需等皇帝诏命。华歆随后出示伪造的诏书，逼迫汉献帝下诏封曹丕为魏王、丞相兼冀州牧。

26. 曹丕即日嗣位，受大小百官拜贺。忽报曹彰自长安提十万大军来到。曹丕知道曹彰性最刚烈，深通武艺。如今率兵远来，定是为了争夺王位，顿时大惊失色。
27. 谏议大夫贾逵挺身而出，奏道：‘臣愿意去见曹彰，用大义来说服他。’众官都道：‘恐怕非你去不可了。’曹丕心喜，派贾逵即刻前去。
page_text_en:
26. Cao Pi ascended the throne immediately and received congratulations from officials of all ranks. Suddenly, news arrived that Cao Zhang had led a hundred-thousand-strong army from Chang'an. Cao Pi knew Cao Zhang was fierce and skilled in martial arts. Now that he had come with troops from afar, it must be to seize the throne, and Cao Pi was instantly shocked and pale.
27. The Censor Jia Kui stepped forward and said, 'I am willing to go and meet Cao Zhang, and persuade him with righteousness.' All the officials said, 'It seems you are the only one who can do it.' Cao Pi was pleased and immediately sent Jia Kui to go.
summary_zh: 曹丕即位后，得知弟弟曹彰率军前来，惊恐万分；谏议大夫贾逵主动请缨，愿以大义说服曹彰，曹丕欣然同意并派他前往。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义40：兄弟争王》

28. 贾逵出城，见了曹彰。曹彰不先提嗣位的事，却质问曹操所遗印信，今在何处？贾逵正色回答：‘家有长子，国有储君，这印信的事，做兄弟的无权过问。’
29. 这一说，说得曹彰默然无话，只得和贾逵一同入城。
page_text_en:
28. Jia Kui went out of the city and met Cao Zhang. Cao Zhang did not first mention the matter of succession, but instead questioned where the seals and credentials left by Cao Cao were now. Jia Kui replied sternly: 'In a family, there is the eldest son; in a state, there is the heir. As a brother, you have no right to inquire about this matter.'
29. Upon hearing this, Cao Zhang was speechless and could only enter the city together with Jia Kui.
summary_zh: 贾逵出城面见曹彰，以‘家有长子，国有储君’的道理劝阻其争夺继承权，曹彰无言以对，只得随贾逵入城。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义40：兄弟争王》

31. 贾逵趁机又道：“既无异心，为何带兵入城呢？”曹彰听他说得有理，当下叫左右将士暂驻城外。
page_text_en:
30. As they neared the palace gate, Jia Kui asked, "Lord, are you coming to mourn, or to claim the throne?" Cao Zhang replied, "I have come to mourn; I have no other intentions.
31. Jia Kui then said, "If you have no other intentions, why bring troops into the city?" Cao Zhang, finding his words reasonable, immediately ordered his officers and soldiers to temporarily stay outside the city.
summary_zh: 贾逵在宫门外质问曹彰来意，曹彰表明只为奔丧；随后贾逵追问为何带兵入城，曹彰听后认为有理，命将士暂驻城外。

32. Cao Zhang entered alone to pay respects to Cao Pi. Remembering the pain of their father's death, the two brothers embraced and wept.
33. Cao Pi ordered Cao Zhang to leave all his troops and horses behind and return quickly to his fiefdom, Yanling. Cao Zhang had no choice but to hand over his military authority and left, dejected.
summary_zh: 曹彰入宫拜见曹丕，兄弟二人因丧父而相拥痛哭；随后曹丕命令曹彰交出兵权，返回封地鄢陵，曹彰只得怏怏离去。

page_text_en:
34. Cao Pi settled into his position as King, appointing Jia Xu as Grand Commandant, Hua Xin as Chancellor, and Wang Lang as Grand Censor, with promotions for officials of all ranks.
35. Hua Xin reported: "Prince Linzi Cao Zhi and Prince Xiaohuai Cao Xiong, both sons of the late King, did not come to mourn. This is a violation of filial piety and also shows disrespect to Your Majesty. They should be punished." Cao Pi, finding this reasonable, immediately sent envoys to both places to punish them.

36. After a few days, messengers from both places returned, reporting that Cao Xiong, fearing punishment, had hanged himself. Cao Zhi, drunk every day, spoke rebellious words, and those around him agreed; not only did he refuse to admit guilt, but he also drove the envoys out with sticks.
37. Cao Pi became furious and ordered Xu褚 to lead 3,000 Tiger Guards to Linzi to capture Cao Zhi and his entourage immediately.

page_text_en:
38. Xu褚 received the order and led his troops to Linzi. The city guards tried to block him, but Xu褚 didn't say a word, slashing several men with his sword and charging into the city.
39. Xu褚 rushed straight to Cao Zhi's residence, only to find Cao Zhi and Ding Yi, Ding Yi, and others drunk.
summary_zh: 许褚奉命率军前往临淄，强行攻入城内，直奔曹植府邸，发现曹植与丁仪、丁廙等人皆醉酒昏睡。

40. 许褚毫无费力，一一绑了。连同府中大小属官，拿解邺城。

page_text_en:
40. Xu褚 had no trouble at all, binding them one by one. Together with the officials of the mansion, they were taken to Yecheng.
41. Cao Pi, furious at the group of literati who flattered Cao Zhi, did not even interrogate them, but immediately executed Ding Yi, Ding Yi, and others.
summary_zh: 许褚率军攻入临淄，将曹植及其府中官员捆绑后押解至邺城；曹丕因憎恨支持曹植的文人，下令不加审问，将丁仪、丁廙等人一并处斩。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义40：兄弟争王》

42. 丁仪等被杀，曹丕召集亲信密商，想进一步收拾曹植。
43. 曹丕母亲卞氏，先闻曹彰兵权被收，继闻曹熊自缢，心里正在悲恸。忽又听到曹植被擒，慌忙从后堂出来，想替曹植说情。
page_text_en:
42. After Ding Yi and others were killed, Cao Pi gathered his close confidants to secretly discuss plans to further deal with Cao Zhi.
43. Cao Pi's mother, Bian Shi, had just learned that Cao Zhang's military power was stripped away, and then heard that Cao Xiong had committed suicide, causing her deep sorrow. Suddenly, she heard that Cao Zhi had been captured, and hurried out from the back hall, intending to plead for him.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹丕在处死丁仪等人后，召集亲信密谋进一步对付曹植；同时，曹丕的母亲卞氏因接连听到曹彰失权、曹熊自缢、曹植被擒的消息，悲痛欲绝，急忙出面为曹植求情。

44. 卞氏对曹丕哭道：“你三弟嗜酒狂妄，不免目无兄长，你要顾念手足之情，保全他的性命。”曹丕分辩道：“母亲放心，他的脾气应该警诫警诫，我断不加害于他。”
45. 卞氏刚走，华歆便奏：“临淄侯怨恨大王，若不早除，必为后患。”曹丕顾虑母命难违。华歆走上一步，凑近曹丕耳边说，只消如此如此。
page_text_en:
44. Bian Shi wept to Cao Pi, "Your third brother is drunk and reckless, inevitably disrespectful to his elder brother. You must consider your brotherly bond and spare his life." Cao Pi replied, "Mother, please rest assured. His temper should be warned and cautioned. I will certainly not harm him."
45. Just after Bian Shi left, Hua Xin reported, "The Prince of Linzi harbors resentment toward the King. If not eliminated early, he will surely become a future threat." Cao Pi was concerned about disobeying his mother's command. Hua Xin stepped forward, leaned close to Cao Pi's ear, and said, 'Just do this, and this.'
summary_zh: 卞氏劝曹丕保全曹植性命，曹丕表面答应；随后华歆进言称曹植为后患，劝曹丕除之，曹丕虽有顾虑，但华歆密谋对策。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义40：兄弟争王》

source_file: 连环画《三国演义40：兄弟争王》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
46. 曹丕便召曹植上殿。曹植见曹丕端坐不动，容色严厉，心里十分惶恐，连忙伏地请罪。
47. 曹丕冷然道：“你我虽是手足，份属君臣，岂能容你狂悖无礼？你常常夸耀才华，我却不信。如今限你七步吟诗一首，即以兄弟为题，却不许犯着兄弟字样。成则饶你，不成从重治罪。”
page_text_en:
46. Cao Pi summoned Cao Zhi to the palace. Seeing Cao Pi sitting motionless with a stern expression, Cao Zhi felt extremely frightened and hurriedly knelt to beg for forgiveness.
47. Cao Pi coldly said, "Although we are brothers, our relationship is also that of sovereign and subject. How can I tolerate your reckless and disrespectful behavior? You often boast of your talent, but I do not believe it. Now, I give you seven steps to compose a poem, with the theme of 'brothers', but you must not use the words 'brother' or 'brothers'. If you succeed, I will spare you; if not, you will be punished severely."
summary_zh: 曹丕召曹植上殿，曹植因恐惧而伏地请罪。曹丕以七步成诗为考验，要求曹植以兄弟为题但不得提及‘兄弟’二字，否则将严惩。

48. 曹植站起，走不了七步，诗已作成。随口念道：“煮豆燃豆箕，豆在釜中泣；本是同根生，相煎何太急！”
49. 曹丕听了，异常感动，不觉垂头滴下泪来。
page_text_en:
48. Cao Zhi stood up, having not taken seven steps, the poem was already composed. He recited spontaneously: 'Boiling beans with bean stalks as fuel, beans weep in the pot; born from the same root, why boil each other so urgently!'
49. Cao Pi, upon hearing this, was deeply moved and involuntarily lowered his head, tears falling.
summary_zh: 曹植在七步内作成诗句，以豆与豆萁的比喻表达兄弟相残之痛；曹丕听后深受触动，流下眼泪。

50. 正在此时，卞氏从殿后转出，厉声责备曹丕逼弟太甚。曹丕见母亲又来干涉，只得罢手。
51. 曹丕将曹植贬为安乡侯。命即日出京，无事不准入朝。
page_text_en:
50. At this moment, Bian Shi emerged from behind the hall, sternly rebuking Cao Pi for persecuting his younger brother too harshly. Seeing his mother intervene again, Cao Pi had no choice but to desist.
51. Cao Pi demoted Cao Zhi to the title of Marquis of Anxiang, ordering him to leave the capital immediately and forbidding him from entering the court unless necessary.
summary_zh: 卞氏出面阻止曹丕加害曹植，曹丕只得罢手；随后曹丕将曹植贬为安乡侯，并命其立即离京，不得随意入朝。

52. 不数日，忽然蜀将孟达，前来献城投降。原来，刘备因刘封、孟达不救关羽，打算杀此二人。孔明认为不能操之过急，主张升二人为郡守，分调开去，然后下手。哪知有人把这消息传开，孟达便连夜投到魏国来。
53. 曹丕怀疑他是诈降。孟达奏道：“臣为不救关公，汉中王（刘备）要杀害臣，因此惧罪来降。别无他意。”
page_text_en:
52. After a few days, suddenly the Shu general Meng Da came to surrender his city. Originally, Liu Bei, because Liu Feng and Meng Da had not rescued Guan Yu, planned to kill the two. Kong Ming believed it was too hasty to act, and proposed to appoint both as prefects, separate them, and then take action. Unknowingly, someone spread this news, and Meng Da fled to Wei overnight.
53. Cao Pi suspected he was feigning surrender. Meng Da said, "I failed to rescue General Guan, and the King of Hanzhong (Liu Bei) wanted to kill me, so I came to surrender out of fear of punishment. I have no other intention."
summary_zh: 本页描绘了蜀将孟达因刘备欲杀他而连夜投降魏国，曹丕怀疑其诈降，孟达解释自己因未能救援关羽而惧罪来降，无其他意图。

54. 正在这时，忽报刘封引五万兵进攻襄阳，单要孟达厮杀（这是诸葛亮使用的以毒攻毒之计）。曹丕说：“你既是真心，便可去襄阳取刘封首级来，我才相信。”
55. 孟达道：“不必动兵，臣以利害劝他，包教刘封前来投降。”曹丕大喜，加封孟达为平阳亭侯，领新城太守，去守襄阳、樊城（后来，刘封兵败，逃回成都，被刘备所杀）。
page_text_en:
54. At this moment, a report came that Liu Feng led 50,000 troops to attack Xiangyang, demanding to fight Meng Da (this was Zhuge Liang's strategy of 'using poison to counter poison'). Cao Pi said, 'If you are truly sincere, go to Xiangyang and bring me Liu Feng's head, then I will believe you.'
55. Meng Da replied, 'There is no need to mobilize troops. I will persuade him with the advantages and disadvantages, and I guarantee Liu Feng will surrender.' Cao Pi was greatly pleased, and bestowed upon Meng Da the title of Marquis of Pingyang, appointed him as the Governor of Xincheng, and ordered him to defend Xiangyang and Fan City (later, Liu Feng was defeated, fled back to Chengdu, and was killed by Liu Bei).
summary_zh: 曹丕怀疑孟达诈降，要求其取刘封首级以证真心；孟达承诺以利害劝降刘封，曹丕大喜，封其为平阳亭侯并命其守襄阳、樊城。

56. 从此曹丕作威作福，比曹操更甚。他仿效汉高祖富贵还乡的故事，统率甲兵三十万，巡幸故乡谯县，祭扫祖墓。
57. 乡中父老迫于威势，少不得遮道迎接，奉觞进酒。曹丕得意，渐渐起了篡位的念头。
page_text_en:
56. From then on, Cao Pi acted with arrogance and tyranny, even more so than Cao Cao. He imitated Emperor Gaozu of Han's story of returning home in wealth and glory, leading thirty thousand armored troops to tour his hometown, Qiao County, to pay respects at his ancestors' graves.
57. The local elders, intimidated by his power, had no choice but to line the roads to welcome him, offering wine and toasts. Cao Pi, feeling triumphant, gradually began to entertain thoughts of usurping the throne.
summary_zh: 曹丕率大军回乡祭祖，乡民被迫迎驾献酒，曹丕因此得意，萌生篡位之心。

58. 华歆、贾诩、李伏等原早有此心，商议一番，便联合朝中文武官员四十余人，直入内殿，来见汉献帝。
59. 华歆面奏：“魏王父子，功德无以复加，愿陛下以帝位让与魏王。臣等商量已定，特来奏请。”献帝大惊，半晌才说出话来。
我高祖创业，世统相传，已历四百年。我纵无能，岂能将祖宗大业等闲弃了？卿等再从长计议。
page_text_en:
58. Hua Xin, Jia Xu, Li Fu, and others had long harbored this intention. After discussing it, they united over forty civil and military officials and entered the inner palace to meet Emperor Xian of Han.
59. Hua Xin presented his petition: "The father and son of the Wei King have merits beyond measure. We wish Your Majesty to cede the imperial throne to the Wei King. We have already decided, and now come to present our request." The Emperor was greatly shocked and only spoke after a long pause.
"My high ancestor established the foundation, and the dynasty has been passed down for four hundred years. Even if I am incapable, how could I lightly abandon the great cause of my ancestors? You all should deliberate further."
summary_zh: 华歆、贾诩、李伏等人联合朝中官员，进入内殿面见汉献帝，请求献帝将帝位禅让给魏王。献帝震惊，表示不愿轻易放弃祖宗基业，要求再从长计议。

Cao Pi granted him the title of Marquis of Shanyang and ordered him to leave immediately.

Since His Majesty is merciful and unwilling to harm you, he grants you the title of Marquis of Shanyang. Leave immediately, and you are not permitted to enter the court without an imperial decree!"
